# CPU golden artifacts

These PNGs and reports were generated by the CPU-only reference path from the
versioned fixture manifest. HLS segments are intentionally not checked in.

Regenerate with:

```text
go run ./cmd/music-fixture -manifest testdata/music-render/manifest.json -out .tmp/music-fixtures
Get-ChildItem .tmp/music-fixtures -Filter *.wav | ForEach-Object {
  $id = $_.BaseName
  go run ./cmd/music-render-compare -cpu-only -input $_.FullName -output-dir (Join-Path '.tmp/music-goldens' $id) -height 360
}
```

Each fixture directory contains CPU `start.png`, `mid.png`, `end.png`,
`report.json`, and `report.md`. The reports include input SHA-256, PNG
SHA-256, FFmpeg version, dimensions, frame count, PTS range, pixel format and
color metadata. These are CPU reference evidence only; they do not constitute
GPU acceptance.
